verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state PlanetScale lets users create, schedule, and restore backups for branches, with daily default backups plus manual backups, point-in-time restore for Postgres branches, and webhook notifications (backup.succeeded/failed) for visibility into backup status. This covers scheduled, visible, self-serve backup/restore workflows for both MySQL/Vitess and Postgres branches. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community confirmation of the backup/restore UX specifically, and no detail on how granular the schedule configuration UI is beyond 'daily default'.
